verdicts.reason: A has real collisions: the last body line ('sunset.') runs into the LIMITED EDITION pill, and the missing-asset box sits on top of the legal text. The can is cropped at the top edge, and the three badges stacked as near-button-sized pills crowd the CTA and pull attention from it. B keeps body copy, headline and CTA clear of each other with a strong headline. Its flaws: the SUNSET SALE ribbon overlaps the AWARD WINNING pill, the badge cluster above the headline looks scattered, the legal text is cramped beside the missing-asset box, and the logo is tiny.
